title: Hybrid Universal Scraper
description: LLM-powered universal web scraper with pattern caching. Works on ANY website without configuration. 99.5% cost savings on cached requests!

startUrls.title: URLs to Scrape
startUrls.description: List of URLs to scrape. The system will automatically detect patterns and extract data.

fields.title: Fields to Extract
fields.description: List of fields to extract (e.g., title, price, description). The LLM will generate semantic extraction patterns for these fields.

openaiApiKey.title: 🔑 OpenAI API Key
openaiApiKey.description: Your OpenAI API key (required for pattern generation). Cost: ~$0.02 per new domain, then $0.0001 for cached patterns. You can also set OPENAI_API_KEY as an environment variable.

useDirectLLM.title: 🤖 Use Direct LLM Extraction
useDirectLLM.description: Enable Direct LLM extraction. Extracts data directly without pattern generation. Recommended for maximum accuracy!

directLLMQualityMode.title: Direct LLM Quality Mode
directLLMQualityMode.description: Quality mode for DirectLLM: 'conservative' (50% fields required, highest quality), 'balanced' (33% fields, default), 'aggressive' (10% fields, maximum items)

hybridConfig.title: ⚙️ Hybrid System Configuration (Advanced)
hybridConfig.description: Advanced configuration for the hybrid system

similarityThreshold.title: Pattern Similarity Threshold
similarityThreshold.description: Threshold for pattern reuse (0.0-1.0). Higher = more strict matching. Recommended: 0.75

enableLLM.title: Enable LLM Pattern Generation
enableLLM.description: Use LLM to generate semantic patterns. If false, uses fallback patterns (free but less accurate).

cachePatterns.title: Cache Generated Patterns
cachePatterns.description: Save patterns to cache for future reuse. Highly recommended for cost savings!

maxContainers.title: Max Containers per Page
maxContainers.description: Maximum number of repeating items to extract per page

proxyConfiguration.title: 🔗 Apify Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Configure Apify residential proxies (recommended for production). Leave empty to use external proxy or no proxy.

useExternalProxy.title: 🌐 Use External Proxy (Bright Data, etc.)
useExternalProxy.description: Enable external proxy instead of Apify proxy. Requires externalProxyServer, externalProxyUsername, and externalProxyPassword.

externalProxyServer.title: External Proxy Server
externalProxyServer.description: External proxy server URL (e.g., http://brd.superproxy.io:33335). Required if useExternalProxy is true.

externalProxyUsername.title: External Proxy Username
externalProxyUsername.description: External proxy username. Required if useExternalProxy is true.

externalProxyPassword.title: External Proxy Password
externalProxyPassword.description: External proxy password. Required if useExternalProxy is true.

webUnblockerApiKey.title: 🌐 Web Unblocker API Key
webUnblockerApiKey.description: Web Unblocker API key (e.g., Bright Data Web Unblocker) for bypassing Kasada/Cloudflare. Used as fallback when standard proxies are blocked. You can also set BRIGHT_DATA_API_KEY as an environment variable.

webUnblockerZone.title: Web Unblocker Zone
webUnblockerZone.description: Bright Data Web Unblocker zone name (default: web_unlocker1)

enableAutoPagination.title: 📄 Enable Auto-Pagination
enableAutoPagination.description: Automatically scrape pages when pagination is detected. WARNING: Some sites have thousands of pages!

maxPages.title: Max Pages to Scrape
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape when auto-pagination is enabled. Leave blank or set to 0 to scrape all pages. Only applies when enableAutoPagination is true.
